summary_en: The caller inquired about the cost of a 3 kW rooftop system and whether a government subsidy was available. The agent provided the details, explaining that the system costs ₹1,95,000, a government subsidy of ₹78,000 applies, leaving a net cost of ₹1,17,000, with an EMI option available at ₹2,999 per month for 48 months. The caller expressed that the pricing seemed reasonable. The agent then proposed booking a free site survey and requested the caller's name, area, and preferred day. The caller agreed to this proposal, but did not provide the requested details before the call ended.
next_action: Agent to follow up to collect the caller's name, area, and preferred day to book the site survey.
